title: God Made the Animals
objective: Students will learn that God created all the animals and that each one is special.
content: God made all the animals! He made big animals and tiny animals. He made fast animals and slow animals.
Some animals have fur, like dogs and cats. Some animals have feathers, like birds. Some animals have scales, like fish. God made each animal special!
God asked Adam to name all the animals. Can you name some animals? God loves all His creatures, and He wants us to take care of them.
activity: Color pictures of your favorite animals. Can you make the sounds the animals make?
discussion: How can we take care of animals?
